cohort: All 145 final analysis participants; excludes the 4 recorded failures from the 149-subject analysis selection

plots.age_distribution: Describe the seven age categories of the actual analyzed cohort
plots.tmt_distribution: Show raw time skew and the response transformation with aligned count axes
plots.oof_metrics: Age/sex-only control bounds any claim of added EEG prediction value
plots.oof_prediction: Show all 145 subject-level held-out predictions on common observed/predicted axes
plots.support_stability: Expose all selected channel, window and band counts across the same five folds

uncertainty: No CI or significance test; OOF metrics use one fixed partition and support counts use five outer fits
support_display: All nonzero-selected channels; zero-count channels explicitly enumerated by count, all 16 windows and all 5 bands shown
baseline_formula: C_test @ saved y_nuisance_coef + saved y_mean; training-only OLS parameters verified independently
export: Editable PDF/SVG text; 300-dpi PNG; slide-size fonts 14-16 pt

source_warning_reviews.EXPORT-RASTER: PNG is the requested presentation preview; PDF/SVG are the authoritative vector exports, no TIFF required
source_warning_reviews.FINAL-WIDTH: These are slide-sized exports, not journal production figures
source_warning_reviews.LOG-GUARD: An explicit assertion of final.tmt5_raw > 0 precedes independent np.log validation
source_warning_reviews.UNCERTAINTY-ENCODING: Pooled OOF metrics use one fixed partition; selected-support counts describe the five fits and are not interval summaries
